notes: Scan 011 is an upright manuscript text leaf headed by the author’s page number 1 and the title Hyperrecouvrements. It has six opening prose baselines, a two-row functor display, seven explanatory prose baselines, two live Hyp 1 baselines, and four baselines of a wholly cancelled Hyp 1′. Counting title, interlinear insertion, four slanted marginal baselines, and the two separate numerals gives 29 physical text/formula/number lines.

The whole original was viewed once for layout, then exactly two native-resolution overlapping halves (1683×1299 each; original height 2361; top box [0,0,1683,1299], bottom [0,1062,1683,2361]) were each viewed once. Nine first-reading crops were generated and actually viewed. No OCR, external research, or TeX compilation was used.
At scan 011, upper paragraph, the single heavy obliteration before la notion remains doubtful as une. The later cancellation clearly stops at hyp; its lack of a final e is not repaired to H’s type.

At scan 011, two-row display, the first arrow is an ordinary right arrow, while the second has a vertical starting bar (mapsto). There is no comma after the first-row category. The extra crossed return at the bottom of the second φ is an open graphical question, represented by a new doubt on φ and a full-formula audit box.

At scan 011, explanatory paragraph, the curved insertion leader rises from just before des recouvrements and carries the quoted interlinear word into the position after yoga. It is not an underline or a cancellation. The article la/le and the capital’s diacritic remain unresolved after their crop. The closely linked et de is also retained under doubt.

At scan 011, explanatory paragraph, y.g. is an explicit two-stop abbreviation and is not expanded in the transcription. Cartier was read letter by letter in the same crop. The compressed word before paracompacts is retained as non after examining the line crop; no extra punctuation is supplied from H’s editorial discussion.

At scan 011, bottom block, induit is actually present at the left of the slice-functor formula. The slanted marginal note overlaps this area; its strokes do not constitute another cancellation of induit. C omitted the word, while H preserved it. The block is globally deleted by two diagonal strokes, and the marginal Est satisfait tautologiquement! remains live.

At scan 011, cancelled penultimate baseline, associé is singular masculine in the ink, with no extra e/s. The spelling is retained even if a reader prefers another grammatical attachment. The final comma after dans A is preserved, and the abandoned condition is not completed.

At scan 011, top and lower left, 1 is the author’s dark-ink page number. The pale 10 at the left of the cancelled block is secondary foliation in another hand; it is preserved as a margin inscription and is not treated as authorial pagination. No date is written on this leaf.

H’s page-number note and its long editorial explanation of yoga/Cechiste are not source text. Changes of math-font wrappers, bold/emphasis wrappers, and display syntax do not create lexical change rows. marked_in_H records explicit uncertainty marking in H, rather than the mere existence of an editorial note.

Independent image-only audit: the curved leader of the Cechiste insertion is now reproduced as a genuine path while the word remains a text node. A local objet|objt doubt is added in Hyp1. The long descending stroke in the lower marginal satisfait is read as part of the letter, not a separately established pointer; the body words induit and i.e. are not reassigned to that note.
